company.name: Fabius
company.shortDescription: Fabius analyzes customer calls with AI to help sales leaders improve their reps' performance.
company.description: Fabius is a platform that uses sales and customer data to support go-to-market activities. The system collects information from calls, emails, documents, training materials, and marketing content. It identifies buying signals, proof points, and common questions from prospects to guide sales teams. Fabius provides pre-call research by analyzing a prospect’s website and related materials. After calls, the platform generates follow-up emails and updates customer records in the CRM. It also creates rubrics for discovery and selling, scores sales representatives, and gives feedback on areas to work on. The platform can be used across the sales process, including prospecting, meetings, ongoing deals, and post-sale activities.
